snapshotPolicy: 185 Bunpro rows and 132 JLPT Sensei rows were observed in the linked publisher inventories. These are source snapshot counts, include overlapping constructions/lexical items, and are neither unique lesson counts nor official JLPT totals. Short topic names are factual mappings; explanations, examples and quizzes in TENKA are original.

sources.scope: N4 section; observed snapshot lines 277 through 637, not permanent source identifiers.
All four N4 inventory pages; publisher ordinal identifies the captured row.

dispositionPolicy.covered_n4: Authored N4 construction mapped within the stated introductory scope; not a claim that every nuance on a linked page is complete.
dispositionPolicy.prerequisite_n5: Existing closed N5 objective, never counted again as a new N4 objective.
dispositionPolicy.partial: Some relevant teaching exists, with an explicit unresolved use or depth check.
dispositionPolicy.pending_grammar: Unresolved grammar objective, composition/application or publisher level difference.
dispositionPolicy.pending_lexical: Meaning-specific vocabulary, example and practice work still required in the N4 vocabulary phase.

closureRequirements: Resolve every partial and pending row with reviewed teaching, meaningful application or a documented scope decision.
Review publisher level differences without moving material into N5 or filling levels to arbitrary totals.
Audit N4 vocabulary, Kanji/Bushu, reading/listening and finite quiz sessions; source row counts alone cannot close N4.
Retain N5 CLOSED, N4/N3 OPEN, N2/N1 deferred, PR #16 draft and no merge/production deployment.
